## GET /v1/goodreads/author - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Goodreads author: name, photo, biography, follower count, number of works (author.posts_count), birthplace (author.location) and website. GET /v1/goodreads/author/books lists their books.

**Use when** you want to profile an author, then chain author/books for everything they have written.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Goodreads author id, for example 656983. Send id or url. · e.g. `656983`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Goodreads author link, for example https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/656983.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.external_url` | Bio link / external website URL when surfaced by the… |

+10 more (types in the full schema): `author` {followers, location, posts_count}; `computed` {content_category, engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `author.ext` {business_hours, products}. Never filled: `author.following`, `author.joined_at`, `author.likes_count`, `author.private`, `author.username`, `author.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/goodreads/author" \
  --data-urlencode "id=656983" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/goodreads/author/books - 1 credit (standard)

Returns an author's books with average rating, rating and review counts, first publication year and edition count, sorted by popularity, title, newest, rating or pages. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to see which of an author's books readers rate highest or talk about most.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · ≈30/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Goodreads author id, for example 656983. Send id or url. · e.g. `656983`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Goodreads author link, for example https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/656983.
- `sort` (optional, enum: popular | title | newest | rating | pages) - popular (default), title, newest, rating or pages.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Books to return, 1 to 30. Default 30.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {id string, work_id string, title string, url string, cover_url string, first_published_year number, pages null, editions_count number, series_position null}; `authors[]` {id string, name string, url string, role null}; `rating` {average number, count number, review_count null}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/goodreads/author/books" \
  --data-urlencode "id=656983" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/goodreads/book - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Goodreads book in full: title, authors and their roles, series and position, description, genres, the average rating with the 1 to 5 star breakdown, rating and review counts, how many reviews exist in each language, the edition's format, pages, publisher, ISBN and ASIN, first publication date, awards, places, characters, and how many readers are currently reading it or want to read it.

**Use when** you want to profile a title: how readers rate it, how many are reading it now, and which edition you are looking at.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Goodreads book id, for example 5907. Send one of id, url or isbn. · e.g. `5907`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Goodreads book link, for example https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/5907.
- `isbn` (optional, string) - An ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, for example 9780547928227.
- `include_similar` (optional, boolean) - true to add similar books. Default false.
- `include_lists` (optional, boolean) - true to add the Listopia lists the book is on. Default false.
- `include_preview` (optional, boolean) - true to add the free reading-sample link when one exists. Default false.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`, `isbn`.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {id string, work_id string, url string, title string, original_title string, description string, cover_url string, genres string[]}; `authors[]` {id string, name string, url string, role string}; `series[]` {id string, title string, url string, position string}; `rating` {average number, count number, review_count number}; `rating.histogram` {1 number, 2 number, 3 number, 4 number, 5 number}; `review_languages[]` {language string} (+22 more).

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/goodreads/book" \
  --data-urlencode "id=5907" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/goodreads/book/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns reader reviews of a Goodreads book, 30 a page: popular (Goodreads' own ranking), newest or oldest, optionally only one star rating, one language, or reviews containing a phrase. Each review has its rating out of 5, text, date, likes (review.helpful_votes) and the reviewer with their review count. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to read what readers actually said. Filter to one star rating, one language, or a phrase to isolate a theme.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free. With `max_pages`, `max_items` or `max_credits`, each page walked is billed at this price (a cached page is free), and `max_credits` caps the total.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · default page size not measured; set with `limit` · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Goodreads book id, for example 5907. Send one of id, url or isbn. · e.g. `5907`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Goodreads book link, for example https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/5907.
- `isbn` (optional, string) - An ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, for example 9780547928227.
- `sort` (optional, enum: popular | newest | oldest) - popular (default), newest or oldest.
- `rating` (optional, integer, 1-5) - Only reviews with this many stars, 1 to 5.
- `language` (optional, string) - Only reviews in this language, a code such as en, es, de or zh-TW. GET /v1/goodreads/book lists the languages a book has reviews in.
- `search` (optional, string) - Only reviews containing these words.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Reviews to return, 1 to 30. Default 30.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` (1) · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality); `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`, `isbn`.
- `reports`, `label_evidence` are no-ops without `label` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `goal`, `fit_tokens` are no-ops without `fit` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `label`: at most 5 comma-separated values.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `review.url` | URL of the review. |
| `review.author.name` | Reviewer name. |
| `review.author.url` | URL of the reviewer's profile. |

+12 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {labels_evidence}; `review` {entity_id, helpful_votes}; `computed.labels` {incentivized, injection, issue, reports, sentiment}; `review.author` {avatar_url, reviews_count}; `review.rating` {max, value}. Never filled: `review.author.location`, `review.images`, `review.language`, `review.original_language`, `review.responses`, `review.source`, `review.title`, `review.translated`, `review.verified`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/goodreads/book/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "id=5907" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/goodreads/lists - 1 credit (standard)

With id or url, returns the books ranked on one Listopia list with rank, score and votes. With tag, returns the lists for that tag with their book and voter counts. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to see what readers rank best in a genre or theme, or to discover lists worth reading.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · ≈30/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - A Listopia list id.
- `url` (optional, string) - A Listopia list link.
- `tag` (optional, string) - A tag whose lists to return, for example fantasy. · e.g. `fantasy`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Rows to return, 1 to 30. Default 30.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`, `tag`.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {id string, title string, url string, books number, voters number}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/goodreads/lists" \
  --data-urlencode "tag=fantasy" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.

**Query params**

- `id` (required) - The review id exactly as GET /v1/goodreads/book/reviews returns it in review.id. · e.g. `kca://review:goodreads/amzn1.gr.review:goodreads.v1.K57x5TdipsgcUAYo53Udhg`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Comments to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.post_id` | ID of the post this comment belongs to |

| `comment.author.display_name` | Comment author display name |

Never filled: `comment.author.username`, `comment.author.verified`, `comment.engagement.likes`, `comment.engagement.replies`, `comment.flags.pinned`, `comment.parent_id`, `comment.url`. ## GET /v1/goodreads/series - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the books of one Goodreads series in reading order, each with its position, rating and counts, plus the series' title and description in data.series.

**Use when** you want to lay out a series in order and compare how readers rate each book.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - A series is returned whole in one call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Goodreads series id, for example 66175. Send id or url. · e.g. `66175`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Goodreads series link.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {id string, work_id string, title string, url string, cover_url string, first_published_year number, pages number, editions_count number, series_position string}; `authors[]` {id string, name string, url string, role null}; `rating` {average number, count number, review_count number}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.series`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/goodreads/series" \
  --data-urlencode "id=66175" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
